BlogPage.title: Blog
BlogPage.subtitle: Product updates, company news, and thoughts on building software for Mongolia.
BlogPage.author: Zuiio Team
BlogPage.post-1-excerpt: Why we're building software for Mongolian businesses, and what we've learned so far.
BlogPage.post-1-content:
We started Zuiio because we saw Mongolian businesses struggling with software built for other markets.

Inventory systems that weren't designed for Mongolian small businesses. Sales tools that didn't work offline. Auto repair software that had never seen a ger district delivery route.

We're building differently.

**Built for Mongolia, from day one.** Every feature, every form, every workflow — it's all designed for the way Mongolian businesses actually work. Not adapted after the fact.

**Offline first.** Internet in Mongolia isn't always reliable. Your software shouldn't stop working when the connection drops. All our products work offline and sync when you reconnect.

**One brand, two products.** Zer is a mini ERP for SMEs — inventory, sales, expenses, customers, and reports. Tolom manages auto repair shops — bay view, work orders, parts, estimates, and mechanics. They share the same design, the same philosophy.

This is just the beginning. We'll be sharing more about what we're building, how we build it, and what we learn along the way.

— The Zuiio Team
BlogPage.post-2-excerpt: A practical walkthrough of Zer's core features — inventory, sales, expenses, and reporting.
BlogPage.post-2-content:
Zer is a mini ERP built for Mongolian small and medium businesses. Here's what you can do from day one.

**Inventory & Stock Management**

Track products, categories, units, and stock levels in real time. Zer gives you automatic stock counts, product codes, price history, and low-stock alerts so you always know what's on your shelves.

**Sales with POS**

Create sales with multi-line entry, customer selection, and payment tracking. The Shop POS module gives you a product catalog, cart, checkout with numeric keypad, and receipt printing — perfect for retail.

**Expense Tracking**

Log expenses by category, amount, date, and payment method. Get monthly expense reports with comparisons and CSV export.

**Customer & Supplier Management**

Store detailed profiles with contact info, balance tracking, and full transaction history for both customers and suppliers.

**Reports & Analytics**

Sales, expense, and profit reports with charts and graphs. Date range filtering, CSV export, and public share links that don't require login.

**Multi-Branch Support**

Manage multiple physical locations with isolated transactions per branch. Get a consolidated accounting view across all branches.

Ready to get started? Create your free account and start tracking your business today.
BlogPage.post-3-title: Why Mongolian Businesses Need Local Software
BlogPage.post-3-excerpt: Off-the-shelf software wasn't built for Mongolia. Here's why local solutions matter.
BlogPage.post-3-content:
Off-the-shelf software wasn't built for Mongolia. Here's why that matters and what we're doing about it.

**The Problem with Imported Software**

Most business software is designed for Western markets. Currency, language, tax rules, payment methods, business hours — none of them match how Mongolian businesses actually work.

**Mongolian Language First**

Your team shouldn't have to work in a second language to manage their own business. Full Cyrillic UI, not adapted — built from the ground up.

**Local Currency, Local Rules**

Mongolian tugrik, local tax formats, Mongolian date conventions. These aren't afterthoughts — they're core to how the software thinks.

**Works Offline**

Internet in Mongolia can be spotty. Our software works offline and syncs when you're back online. Your data is never lost.

**Built for Mongolian SMEs**

Not enterprise. Not startup. Built for the businesses that make up 99% of Mongolia's economy — shops, workshops, repair bays, gyms, herders.

PrivacyPage.section-1-b4: Payment and subscription information processed by our payment providers. We do not intentionally store full card numbers on our own servers.
PrivacyPage.section-2-p0: We use information to operate Zuiio products, keep accounts secure, respond to support requests, improve reliability, and comply with legal and platform requirements.

PrivacyPage.section-5-p1: Workspace owners are responsible for responding to requests from their own employees, customers, suppliers, and repair-shop clients when that data is controlled by the workspace.
PrivacyPage.section-6-p0: We use administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect information against unauthorized access, loss, misuse, alteration, or disclosure. PrivacyPage.section-7-p0: Zuiio services are for businesses and are not directed to children. If you believe a child provided personal information to us, contact info@zuiiotech.com so we can review and delete it where appropriate.
PrivacyPage.section-8-p0: For privacy questions, data requests, or platform review inquiries, email info@zuiiotech.com with the subject line “Privacy request.”
